_comment: Draft balance rules for tools/generate_career_forks.py. Every number is a draft the maintainer approves through the review table (--table). Change a number here, never in the generator. The C# sets (consumed, class-filtered, mask-gated, flat) are read from Main/Features/CareerSystem at run time and are not repeated here. One value unit (VU) is about one median shipped pip. Every effect type with a vu_unit must sit in a cap group, and the root pip may not pass root_budget plus budget_tolerance.

banned.StealthBonus: no consumer worth a pip; the fork trees do not use it
banned.Special: the parse-fallback sentinel, never an authored type
banned.BuffDuration: reserved and unconsumed: a pip nothing reads
banned.ShrugOff: on/off: any positive pick is permanent stagger, knockdown and dismount immunity
banned.CompanionLimit: a whole-number count (the model truncates it), and not in the maintainer's priorities
banned.SmithingCostReduction: not in the maintainer's priorities, and the name invites the wrong sign

vu_notes.Damage: from the plan's bands: 0.15 is a 3 VU tier 1 pick
vu_notes.TroopDamage: army-wide; a class-only effect gets class_bonus
vu_notes.TroopResistance: army-wide; a class-only effect gets class_bonus
vu_notes.SpecialResourceUpkeepModifier: a cost type, so the benefit is the negative magnitude; -1.0 (elites cost no daily upkeep) is the plan's 3 VU tier 1 pick
vu_notes.SpecialResourceUpgradeCostModifier: a cost type; draft, set equal to the old upkeep unit
vu_notes.TroopKnockdownResistance: draft; covers the engine's weapon, charge and dismount knockdown checks, not TAOM's forced knockdowns (signature strikes, the mumakil trample, troll brute force)
vu_notes.RenownGain: the plan bundles renown and influence at 25% each in one 3 VU tier 1 pick (2 + 1)
vu_notes.InfluenceGain: priced cheaper than renown because it is 0 outside a kingdom; kept bundled with RenownGain
vu_notes.Resistance: the plan's 'you take 20% less damage' is a 5 VU tier 3 pick
vu_notes.TroopMorale: a factor on base morale 50 (TaomPartyMoraleModel), not a count; shipped pips run 0.03 to 0.20
vu_notes.TroopWages: a cost type, so a wage cut (negative) is the benefit
vu_notes.RecruitCost: a cost type; summed with the buyer perks before the 1 gold floor
vu_notes.ArmorPenetration: draft, by analogy with Damage; it shares the Damage cap because it is a second damage multiplier after armour
vu_notes.Ammo: draft, from the shipped 0.10 to 0.15 range
vu_notes.MountHealth: draft, from the shipped 0.10 to 0.13 range
vu_notes.MountChargeDamage: draft, from the shipped 0.10 to 0.15 range. OPEN: a root of 0.10 is 3.03 VU, above the root limit of 2 (root_budget plus budget_tolerance), and 7 shipped cavalry roots carry exactly that (eotheod_windrider, clanguard_rider, chariot_warlord, mahud_beast_rider, balchoth_kan, shaghana_beast_rider, abanissa_ivory_rider). Decided 2026-10-15 under the maintainer's delegation: when a batch regenerates one of them, its root shrinks to 0.05 (1.5 VU), because the plan keeps the root a small identity perk; the maintainer can still re-price this unit or raise root_budget instead
vu_notes.PrisonerConversion: the recruiting party's prisoner experience per hour; rounded per hour, so a +4% can vanish at low Leadership
vu_notes.FoodConsumption: a cost type: the daily food number is negative, so a more negative magnitude eats less
vu_notes.WoundRecovery: positive healing on the leader's party only
vu_notes.DailyGold: flat count of gold per day
vu_notes.LootGold: the winner's own share of plundered gold
vu_notes.RaidLoot: village gold, drawn items at 0.5 x, village goods, common loot at 0.25 x
vu_notes.TroopTraining: flat count of experience per troop per day, class-filtered
vu_notes.TradePrices: a cost type; the runtime keeps a cut past -1 at the floor, it does not drop it

cap_notes.Damage+ArmorPenetration: ArmorPenetration is a second damage multiplier after armour, so it counts with Damage
cap_notes.Resistance: a total of 1 or more makes the hero immune to the matching hits
cap_notes.RaidLoot: the item chance 0.5 x the multiplier stays below certainty
cap_notes.TradePrices: past -1 the runtime must keep the floor, not drop the bonus
cap_notes.TroopUpgradeCost: benefit-signed; the runtime has no floor, so a total cut past -1 would give a negative upgrade price
cap_notes.SpecialResourceUpgradeCostModifier: benefit-signed; capped like TroopUpgradeCost, the same kind of price cut
cap_notes.Ammo: benefit-signed draft, set from the shipped 0.10 to 0.15 pips
cap_notes.Health: benefit-signed draft; a flat count, 50 is the largest total any build may reach
cap_notes.MountChargeDamage: benefit-signed draft, held at the Damage+ArmorPenetration limit
cap_notes.MovementSpeed: benefit-signed draft; the same limit as PartyMovementSpeed, which is 5 VU for both at their 0.03 unit
cap_notes.PartyMovementSpeed: benefit-signed draft; the same limit as MovementSpeed, a gain of the same kind on the map
cap_notes.SwingSpeed: benefit-signed draft; 0.15 is only 3 VU at the 0.05 unit (every other new cap is 5 VU or more), so one tier 1 pick fits and a SwingSpeed-only option cannot pass in fork slots 3 to 6; raise it to 0.25 for 5 VU if that is not wanted
